title: Wedge-Width Correlates Descriptive Qualification

scope.question: descriptive association of frozen Q10-SM local wedge width with prespecified event-local geometry fields

engineering_population.stage_b_entry_rule: Stage A lineage, receipt parity, derivations, deterministic analysis, and independent review pass without any contract change
engineering_population.change_after_stage_a: new protocol identity and fresh engineering seeds required

analysis_populations.ambiguous_event_rule: any Q10_SM_STAGE1_VALID__NUMERICALLY_AMBIGUOUS event yields Q10_WC_NOT_INTERPRETABLE__NUMERICALLY_AMBIGUOUS and stops descriptive interpretation
analysis_populations.coverage_rule: exactly one receipt for every seed x side x tau_bits x trial key

width_outcome.interpretation: larger theta is a wider locally reachable path-safe wedge within the frozen Q10-SM constructor family

null_geometry.null_energy_admission: true_norm and true_null_norm present and finite and true_norm > 0

explicit_wedge_correlates_rules: Wedge width is only the accepted Q10-SM path-safe rotation theta, not global feasible-manifold width.
Theta is canonical; residual cosine and 1-cosine are deterministic mirrors, not separate discoveries.
Canonical correlates are limited to x_slack, f_boundary_active, n_support, n_null, admitted f_null_energy, and t.
Associations are conditional on Q10-SM acceptance; dominated events receive no synthetic width.
Events are nested repeated geometry observations; pooled event count is not an independent-replicate count.
No imputation, jitter, continuity correction, winsorization, or silent row deletion is allowed.
Association magnitude is not importance, mechanism, constraint, or cause.
No outcome may select a future cosine, rotation, correlation, repair, constructor, scientific, or behavioral gate.

numerical_conventions.receipt_arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64; all analyzed values finite
numerical_conventions.event_key: seed, side, binary64 tau bit pattern, trial
numerical_conventions.tie_definition: identical binary64 bit patterns after the frozen transformation
numerical_conventions.undefined_correlation: fewer than required pairwise-complete rows or zero rank sum of squared deviations
numerical_conventions.quantile_method: Hyndman-Fan type 7 with h=(n-1)q and linear interpolation for q in 0.25, 0.5, 0.75
numerical_conventions.slack_transform: correctly rounded log10 from the pinned analysis runtime, finite positive inputs only
numerical_conventions.plain_language_direction: positive, negative, or zero from coefficient sign; magnitude adjectives forbidden
numerical_conventions.display_rounding_rule: round only after computation; displayed values never feed later calculations

outputs: accepted and dominated predictor median and interquartile range

pairwise_associations.metric: Spearman correlation using average ranks for ties
pairwise_associations.undefined_handling: report undefined with reason; never replace with zero

dependence_aware_summaries.timing_window_outputs: theta and c median and interquartile range by fixed timing window, side, and tau

fixed_multivariable_summaries.continuous_transform: average rank over the frozen model row set, then center and scale using population standard deviation

core_model.population: all accepted events with complete admitted core variables
core_model.formula: rank(theta) ~ rank(x_slack) + rank(f_boundary_active) + rank(n_support) + rank(n_null) + rank(t) + seed indicators + side indicator + tau indicator

null_energy_model.formula: rank(theta) ~ rank(x_slack) + rank(f_boundary_active) + rank(n_support) + rank(n_null) + rank(f_null_energy) + rank(t) + seed indicators + side indicator + tau indicator
null_energy_model.admission: fit only when f_null_energy is available for every core-model row
null_energy_model.missing_rule: if any core-model row lacks admitted f_null_energy, report model unavailable; no complete-case subset model

fixed_multivariable_summaries.instability_rule: if SST=0, design rank deficient, or condition number > 1e10, label numerically unstable and do not interpret coefficients

integrity_and_review.failure_rule: fail closed; no silent exclusion or repair

required_outputs_if_later_authorized: fixed core and conditional null-energy multivariable summaries, explicit unavailability, or numerical-instability declarations
claims_explicitly_forbidden: future threshold or gate selected from descriptive outcomes
assumptions: Q10-SM event construction and receipt semantics remain frozen and reproducible for fresh engineering seeds.
The measured wedge is the best path-safe endpoint found by the frozen 16-candidate Q10-SM constructor, not the global box-constrained feasible manifold.
Rotation angle and residual cosine describe the same accepted geodesic rotation; angle is canonical for numerical readability.
Active boundary occupancy is derived within permitted support; whole-state fixed boundary count is a separate diagnostic.
Reversal trial is a deterministic event ordinal and may be temporally dependent with geometry.
Events within a seed-side-tau trajectory are not independent experimental replicates.
Accepted-event associations are conditional on constructor acceptance, which is exposed by the separate selection audit.
Correlated predictors may describe overlapping geometry; coefficients and pairwise associations do not establish cause.
No descriptive outcome may select a later threshold, seed, subgroup, model, constructor, scientific endpoint, or behavioral gate.
No biological claim follows from this synthetic engineering audit.
